name: Dependant's Pass

requirements.blocker_text: Must be a spouse or child (or other qualifying dependant) of a Kenyan citizen, work permit holder, permanent resident, or exempted person, with documentary evidence of the relationship.
Sponsor must show proof of sufficient income to support the dependant, plus a sworn affidavit demonstrating the dependant's inability to self-sustain.

evidence_required.document: Sponsor's valid work permit (6+ months validity, if applicable)

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the source located in this build; tied to the sponsor's status validity

sources.title: Directorate of Immigration Services, Republic of Kenya -- Dependant's Pass: for spouses/children of Kenyan citizens, work permit holders, permanent residents, or exempted persons; requires Form 28, relationship evidence, proof of sponsor's sufficient income, sworn affidavit of dependency; fees KSh 20,000 (dependants of citizens), KSh 10,000 (dependants of permit/PR holders), gratis for EAC nationals

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kenya). Published on tier-1 sourcing (Directorate of Immigration Services). This is the route a foreign spouse of a Kenyan citizen actually lives on day-to-day, distinct from ke_citizenship_by_marriage.json (Section 11 registration, which requires 7 years of marriage plus acquired residence status before citizenship itself can be sought). work_rights set to 'none' since no source in this build described an independent right for a Dependant's Pass holder to work; family_can_work set false as the conservative default.
